messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — we need to re-prioritize partner engagement work before the QBR. New asks from Marketplace + an SI integration slipped in, and MDF runway looks tight.
jin: +1. can you share the list of commitments? are we talking re-allocating existing MDF or asking finance for top-up?
sam: I pulled the partner pipeline this morning — 6 partners in play for joint announcements, 3 of those need marketplace listing support. MDF usage projection currently shows a 22% shortfall for the quarter.
anita: Is the shortfall driven by one big partner or many small pilots? that changes how we triage.
maria: It's a mix. biggest chunk = launch credits for two hardware bundles (NVidia SI + Rack OEM pilot). rest is smaller co-marketing asks.
alex: For announcement runway, we can stagger PRs: prioritize marketplace+SI combo for highest ARR lift. ask: what's the minimum MDF to get the SI integration to GA?
sam: Minimum to unblock dev/test + listing: `USD 45k` (covers engineering time + marketplace fees + joint validation). We can reduce to `~30k` if partner agrees to share 50% of validation labor.
leo_pm: product constraints: need partner feature gating on our side — dev estimate 3 sprints. If MDF only covers listing, time-to-GA still ~8 weeks.
jin: Suggestion: create a triage rubric: 1) revenue delta, 2) time-to-live, 3) partner cost-share. We can then reallocate MDF from low-impact co-marketing.
anita: +1 to rubric. also add strategic tier weight (tier 1 partners get preference).
partners-bot: Reminder: QBR package deadline in 9 business days — upload scorecards to the shared drive: https://redwood.example.com/partnerships/qbr-packages
maria: OK — proposed immediate steps: 1) sam to publish a short spreadsheet with partner, requested MDF, partner cost-share, ETA, ARR uplift; 2) jin + anita to run rubric scoring and recommend top 3; 3) alex to own announcement sequencing; 4) leo_pm to write risk notes for product timeline. Can everyone ack?
sam: I'll drop the sheet in 2 hours. filename: `2765439999-partner-triage-mdf.csv`
jin: I'll run scores after sheet lands. targeting end of day for recommendations.
anita: ack. I'll flag any contractual blockers.
alex: ack. will draft sequencing and PR windows.
leo_pm: ack. will add dev risk and suggested mitigations.
maria: Great. If finance denies top-up, we'll pivot to partner cost-share model and delay lower-impact PRs. I'll follow up with Finance if we need the extra runway.
sam: FYI — there is one legacy MDF holdback from a previous quarter (USD 12k) that might be re-allocated. I'll try to surface it.
jin: Cool. tagging @partners-bot to remind us 48h before QBR package due.
partners-bot: Noted. Reminder set for 48 hours before 2765516399.
maria: Thanks team — will reconvene after scores are in. short thread to keep things tidy. :thumbsup:
